anchor.snippet: test('normal launcher opens native NOLF, source tree, editor, shell and installed Codex together', { timeout: 120000 }, async () => {

entries.note: The ordinary npm launcher owns build, sidecar startup and all initial sessions. Copy the real NOLF executable and link only REZ files to keep writes to autoexec.cfg/Save isolated. Add the real source root through native controls and retain its README as a local draft; only a temporary second README receives Save/conflict writes. Read-only service snapshots corroborate identity, while native input drives actions. Pace the Codex slash command like typed keys so its paste-burst heuristic does not interpret Enter as pasted text. No coding prompt is submitted. Evidence and private connection data stay in ignored local state; source-controlled evidence contains hashes.
